$Comment: Snowman hug (2026-10-21: 'the hug has no animation, nobody can tell he is hugging'). Was Parent Fox_Bite: a 0.167 s fox wind-up and a fox-sized reach (2 blocks), so on the 2.5-block snowman the 0.5 s Hug animation (set AT_Snowman, 30 frames) was cut as soon as the bite ended. Now his own steps, same layout as vanilla Fox_Bite: 0.35 s wind-up with the Hug animation (arms wrap forward, furious face), the hit (Horizontal selector reaching 3 blocks, 1.5 above and 0.5 below his body line; Bite_Damage var from AT_Snowman_Minion = weak hit + 2 s freeze), then 0.6 s holding the hug. Tune the reach with EndDistance (and the role's AttackDistance), the timing with the RunTimes.
